SOUTHBOUND DEPARTURE ROUTES VIA C-D-E TRACKS ARE ANTICIPATED TO BE IMPACTED CAUSING CODED DEPARTURE ROUTES (CDR'S) AND/OR SWAPS. POSSIBLE DELAYS AND MIT MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH THIS INITIATIVE AND MAY CAUSE LONGER THAN NORMAL DEPARTURE WAIT TIMES. PLEASE FUEL ACCORDINGLY. FUEL ADVISORY: PLEASE FUEL ACCORDINGLY FOR POSSIBLE CDR'S, PLAYBOOKS, TACTICAL REROUTES AND OTHER TMI'S DUE TO AIRSPACE BEING AFFECTED BY CONVECTIVE WEATHER.

WHEN THE THE DRAS ARE NO LONGER REQUIRED TO PROTECT THE SAFETY OF FLIGHT, AN UPDATE WILL BE SENT OUT ADVISING THE INVLOVED AIRSPACE IS RELEASED AND THAT NORMAL TRAFFIC HAS RESUMED.
